question.worked_solution:
The electrostatic force $F$ is directly proportional to the square of the charge $q,$ so we have

$$
F=k{q}^{2},
$$

where $k$ is the constant of variation.

We are told that $F=8\,976\,\text{N}$ when $q=2\,\text{C}.$ We can use this information to solve for $k,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}8\,976 & =k\cdot {2}^{2} \\ 8\,976 & =k\cdot 4 \\ \frac{8\,976}{4} & =k \\ 2\,244 & =k\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our direct variation equation is

$$
F=2\,244{q}^{2}.
$$
